claims.statement: NEPO is the production codename for the Vietnamese trucking/logistics platform; TingTing is the historical/marketing brand and the two refer to the same system (marketed as TingTing in some seed scripts and design docs).

The wiki task-routing map points to backend/api-routes.md for adding a REST endpoint (with casbinAuthz + Zod schema), backend/database-schema.md for Drizzle migrations (pnpm db:generate, make prod-migrate excludes *.revert.sql), frontend/app.md for editing pages, frontend/hooks.md for custom hooks, backend/ledger.md for ledger work (ADJUSTMENT/UNLOCK_REVERSAL only), shared/calculations.md for fuel/allowance math, backend/auth-rbac.md for Casbin policy edits, shared/schemas.md for Zod schemas with z.infer, development/testing.md for diagnosis, and deployment.md for prod rollout.

Authoritative Vietnamese documents in docs/ are: CONTEXT.md (domain glossary), docs/flows/DELIVERY_TRIP_LIFECYCLE.md (trip QA guide), docs/flows/00-…15-*.md (role-by-role test scripts), docs/code-standards.md (conventions), docs/codebase-summary.md (codebase map), docs/system-architecture.md (architecture), docs/deployment-guide.md (deployment), PRODUCT-SPECS.md, and ROADMAP.md — the wiki pages are a navigation index, not a re-authoring.

Conventions at a glance: TypeScript strict no any, Zod schemas with z.infer over hand-rolled interfaces, Vietnamese user copy with VND integer display and exact numeric(15, 0) ledger / numeric(15, 2) cost columns, one driver per trip, append-only ledger, Vietnamese audit messages, casbinAuthz + requireRoles dual-layer RBAC, Tailwind v4 (no tailwind.config), no !important, no raw DB IDs in UI text, mobile-first for DRIVER/FORWARDER.
